summary: PowerShell logic is solid (strict mode, error handling, parameter validation), workflow YAML uses pinned actions and least-privilege permissions well. However: (1) Workflow test step fails silently if ./tests directory missing—should check before `Invoke-Pester -Path ./tests`. (2) JSON detection logic duplicated: Get-CurrentVersion ~L31-33 and Update-VersionFile ~L133-134 should be factored into helper function. (3) Task requires test infrastructure (fixtures, `act-result.txt` generation, test harness) not evident in deliverable. Code is maintainable in isolation but duplication creates friction on future edits.
